title: Localization of a weakly convergent integer multiplicity sequence near closure(W) (Simon Ch. 6, 7.2, (4))
statement: Assume the following five propositions. (SL) [the frozen statement of the sibling declaration cmc_slice_mass_bounds] For all P, k ∈ ℕ, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P, T ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(U), Borel measures μ, μ' on ℝ^P that are finite on compact subsets of U, maps ξ (to (k+1)-vectors) and ξ' (to k-vectors) that are μ- resp. μ'-a.e. strongly measurable such that for μ-a.e. x, |⟨α, ξ(x)⟩| ≤ |α| for every (k+1)-covector α, for μ'-a.e. x, |⟨α, ξ'(x)⟩| ≤ |α| for every k-covector α, T(ω) = ∫⟨ω, ξ⟩ dμ for ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(U) and ∂T(η) = ∫⟨η, ξ'⟩ dμ' for η ∈ 𝒟^k(U), and every L-Lipschitz f : ℝ^P → ℝ (L ∈ [0, ∞)), there are currents A_t ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(U), B_t ∈ 𝒟_k(U) (t ∈ ℝ) with A_t(ω) = ∫_{f<t}⟨ω, ξ⟩ dμ, B_t(η) = ∫_{f<t}⟨η, ξ'⟩ dμ', ∂A_t(η) = B_t(η) whenever tsupport η misses {f = t}, M_W(∂A_t − B_t) ≤ L·liminf_{h→0+} ENNReal.ofReal(h⁻¹)·μ(W ∩ {t − h < f < t}) for every open W and t, and ∫⁻_{(a,b)} M_W(∂A_t − B_t) dt ≤ L·μ(W ∩ {a < f < b}) for every open W and a, b. (BR) [the second conjunct of the frozen statement of cmc_closure_and_boundary_rectifiability] For all P, d ∈ ℕ, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P and every IM R ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(U) with M_V(∂R) < ∞ for every open V with closure(V) compact and contained in U, the boundary ∂R is IM. (IR) [conjunct (b) of the frozen statement of the sibling declaration cmc_imRep_locality_restrict_sub] For all P, n ∈ ℕ, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P, every IMRep R = (M, θ, ξ) in U and every Borel set E ⊆ ℝ^P, there are a current A ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and an IMRep R' in U with carrier M ∩ E, multiplicity θ and orientation ξ such that R' represents A. (IO) [conjunct (d) of the frozen statement of cmc_imRep_locality_restrict_sub] For all P, n ∈ ℕ, every U ⊆ ℝ^P and every IMRep R = (M, θ, ξ) in U: for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M, |⟨α, ξ(x)⟩| ≤ |α| for every n-covector α. (ME) [the frozen statement of the sibling declaration cmc_massOn_eq_imRep_measure] For all P, n ∈ ℕ, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and IMRep R in U representing T: M_W(T) = R.measure(W) for every open W ⊆ ℝ^P. Let P, m ∈ ℕ, n := m + 1, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, let T_j (j ∈ ℕ) and T be integer multiplicity currents in 𝒟_n(U) with sup_j (M_V(T_j) + M_V(∂T_j)) < ∞ for every open V with closure(V) compact and contained in U, and T_j ⇀ T in U, and let W ⊆ ℝ^P with closure(W) compact and contained in U. Then there are a strictly increasing φ : ℕ → ℕ, a compact K ⊆ U, Λ ∈ [0, ∞) and integer multiplicity T'_j (j ∈ ℕ), T' ∈ 𝒟_n(U) such that for every j: spt T'_j ⊆ K, M(T'_j) ≤ Λ and M(∂T'_j) ≤ Λ; T'_j ⇀ T' in U; and T'_j(ω) = T_{φ(j)}(ω) and T'(ω) = T(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ W. Conventions: 𝒟_d(U) is the space of d-currents in U (SimonGMT GeometricCurrentOn U d) and 𝒟^d(U) the test d-forms in U (TestFormOn U d: smooth forms on ℝ^P with compact support contained in U); |α| is the Euclidean coefficient norm of a covector (covectorEuclideanNorm); M_G(X) = X.massOn G is the supremum of max(X(ω), 0) over ω ∈ 𝒟^d(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ G and |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x (such ω are called admissible for M_G), and M(X) = X.mass = M_U(X) for X ∈ 𝒟_d(U); spt is the support of Simon 6.2.11 (GeometricCurrentOn.support); IM means integer multiplicity (contract IsIntegerMultiplicity), an IMRep R = (M, θ, ξ) is the contract structure IMRep with R.measure = θ·Hⁿ⌞M, R.action(ω) = ∫_M θ⟨ω, ξ⟩ dHⁿ (⟨ω, ξ⟩ := ξ(x)(ω(x))) and R represents X when X(ω) = R.action(ω) for all test forms ω; subtraction of currents is the contract instance Sub; X ⇀ Y is WeaklyConvergesOn.
